name: JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong
positioning: Luxury city hotel above Pacific Place, directly connected to Admiralty MTR station, with harbour, mountain or skyline views
best_for: Travelers who want direct MTR access and Pacific Place on the doorstep
Business travelers who need an ergonomic in-room workspace

facts.text: The hotel is connected to the MTR and neighbors key offices in Central, so it tends to draw business travelers.
The hotel offers easy access to the shopping, dining and business districts, as well as Victoria Peak and Lan Kwai Fong.
Room windows face either Victoria Harbour or the lush Peak mountain.
Marble bathrooms have lighted makeup mirrors and Aromatherapy Associates products.
All rooms and suites have ergonomic workspaces and complimentary coffee and tea.
Suites have extra space and Lounge access.
Beds are Marriott Signature Beds, with extra support in the pocketed coils.
The fitness center is open 24 hours.
Pilates and group fitness classes are offered on weekends.
The Lounge has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views and serves an afternoon tea set.
The Executive Lounge offers an American breakfast, Asian delights and Happy Hour hors d'oeuvres.
Event venues include a pillarless ballroom, outdoor spaces and modern conference rooms.

highlights.text: The hotel sits above Pacific Place and is directly connected to Admiralty MTR station.
Rooms have views over Victoria Harbour, the scenic mountains or the downtown skyline.
A temperature-controlled outdoor pool and a sauna are on the seventh floor.
Fish Bar is an alfresco seafood restaurant using fresh herbs from JW Garden, amid lush greenery.
Guests are greeted with a pot of Chinese tea and fresh fruit on arrival.

considerations.text: The hotel has no spa; massages can be booked at the health club.
The busy address feels a little chaotic during the day but winds down in the evening.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting its luxury positioning in the Hong Kong market.
